title: Rescaled retractions onto the blown-up constraint sets η_{x_j,λ_j}(U ∩ N) at moving centres
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, N ⊆ ℝ^P with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and x ∈ U. Assume that if x ∈ N there are δ > 0 and π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with π C¹ on B_δ(x), π(B_δ(x)) ⊆ N, π(y) = y for y ∈ N ∩ B_δ(x), and for every η > 0 some s ∈ (0, δ] with |π(y) − π(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for y, z ∈ B_s(x). Let x_j ∈ ℝ^P with x_j → x and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, and A_j := η_{x_j,λ_j}(U ∩ N) (η_{x_j,λ_j} = dilation x_j λ_j). Then for every G > 0 there are maps π_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) and G′ ∈ ℝ such that: for all large j, either A_j ∩ B_G(0) = ∅, or π_j is C¹ on B_G(0), maps B_G(0) into A_j ∩ B_{G′}(0) and π_j(y) = y for y ∈ A_j ∩ B_G(0); and for every η > 0, for all large j, either A_j ∩ B_G(0) = ∅ or |π_j(y) − π_j(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_G(0). (B_s(y) = ball y s; 'for all large j' = eventually in atTop.)
